
## Appendix: detailed records

```{r read-detail, include=FALSE}
detail <- read.csv("raw/detail.csv", check.names = FALSE)
```

This synthetic example shows all `r nrow(detail)` records. Search by record ID, sort by a column,
or scroll inside the table to inspect measurements. [Complete CSV](`r report_root_prefix`raw/detail.csv).

<style>
.detail-table {max-width: 100%; min-width: 0; overflow-x: auto;}
</style>

```{r detail-table, echo=FALSE}
htmltools::div(class = "detail-table",
  DT::datatable(detail, rownames = FALSE, class = "stripe compact", width = "100%",
                options = list(pageLength = 8, lengthChange = FALSE, scrollX = TRUE, autoWidth = TRUE)))
```
